name: repo-bootstrap
description: Optional on-demand interactive initializer for new or unconfigured repositories. Runs a safe read-only environment readiness probe, audits existing files without overwriting them, and scaffolds only the governance and workflow starters you opt into (lean <800-token AGENTS.md, modular safe/gated Justfile, optional review-only CODING_STANDARDS.md, lazy GLOSSARY.md/docs/adr/, and a tests/governance/ placeholder).
suggestedPrompts: Bootstrap this repository with an opt-in governance and workflow checklist
Run a safe read-only environment readiness probe and audit what this repo is missing
Scaffold a lean AGENTS.md and modular safe/gated Justfile for this new repo
